block.title: The transliteration proof opens in 19 seconds
block.p: Glibc’s conversion proof now reads the four transliteration arrays from the compiled C locale object. It gets ten symbol addresses and region ends from the extracted loader. Hello’s startup proofs check those addresses and show that its loaded memory contains the table bytes.

Rocq reports 75 transitive glibc imports for the conversion, down from 436. On swa, rq open libio/LibioWConvTranslit.v --theorem flags_step reached its first goal in 19.4 seconds. The previous run took 124 seconds. Both used an empty interface cache, a compiled Nanofil model and eight make jobs. Other builds shared the host. The earlier measurement is in .
